updates.title: Antonelli completes a Friday sweep at Lusail
updates.body: Kimi Antonelli lowered the Friday benchmark to 1:23.077. George Russell closed to 0.127 seconds, and McLaren took third and fourth with Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri.

updates.title: Mercedes leads opening Qatar practice
updates.body: Kimi Antonelli set a 1:23.217 to lead George Russell by 0.507 seconds. Isack Hadjar was third for Red Bull.

updates.title: Qatar race week opens at Lusail
updates.body: FP1 starts Friday at 5:30 a.m. PST, qualifying starts Saturday at 10:00 a.m. PST, and Sunday’s 57-lap Grand Prix starts at 8:00 a.m. PST.

updates.title: Pirelli’s 27-lap tyre limit puts two stops on the agenda
updates.body: The cap applies to each set across the weekend, including laps run under the Safety Car or Virtual Safety Car. Pirelli has selected C1 hard, C2 medium and C3 soft.
updates.sourceLabel: Autosport reporting on Pirelli’s tyre limit
